townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.
townsfolk.flavor: Certainly madam, under normal circumstances, you may borrow the Codex Malificarium from the library vaults. However, you do not seem to be a member.
townsfolk.summary: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the Minion character token. Point to both the *MINION* and *WRONG* players.
townsfolk.flavor: It is a fine night for a stroll, wouldn't you say, Mister Morozov? Or should I say... BARON Morozov?
townsfolk.summary: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Point clockwise or anticlockwise around the circle.
townsfolk.flavor: これは夢。それも夢。すべて夢です。
townsfolk.summary: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.

townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Show a player with a different character type to previously.
townsfolk.flavor: More heat! Higher! Higher! Più alto! Ahhh... it is so beautiful from up here, don't you agree? Can you see the children fishing by the river, under the willow? Can you see the  glint of the sun on the circus tent-poles? What's this? An old man, alone, passed out in the vineyard? Less heat! Lower! Lower! Vai più in basso!
townsfolk.summary: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.
townsfolk.flavor: I remember the Clockmaker. The sky was red and it was raining fractal triangles. There was a smell of violets and a bubbling sound. A woman with glowing eyes and a scraggly beard was hissing at the sky. Then, I awoke.
townsfolk.summary: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up.
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up.
townsfolk.flavor: Effendi... I am but a humble man, but my pipe is golden and a single tune will tame the wildest djinn, Inshallah. They say that greed hangs more men than rope. But not I, Effendi... not I.
townsfolk.summary: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.

townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Either nod or shake your head.
townsfolk.flavor: Hear ye! Hear ye! Witchcraft in the labyrinth! Genius savant reveals all! Town in danger! Hear Ye!
townsfolk.summary: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.
Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.

townsfolk.flavor: Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor... the sun sets early but the moon is unchanged... a torn piece of cloth... evil in the manor house... three by three... the one we trusted is not what he seems... green light means magnesium... residue, but the pattern is wrong... Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor...
townsfolk.summary: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Run the Amnesiac's ability, if applicable.
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Run the Amnesiac's ability, if applicable.
townsfolk.flavor: Wait. What. Who? Oh, ok. Wait. What?
townsfolk.summary: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head.
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head.
townsfolk.flavor: Did you hear that stranger in the cashmere coat put the word on our young Belle? And she said yes? Well, that's nothing compared to what Harry and that juggler got up to at the fair! The things I could say if I was a tattletale... my, yes.
townsfolk.summary: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Courtier might choose a character.
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Courtier might choose a character.
townsfolk.flavor: I am more afraid of an army of one hundred sheep led by a lion than an army of one hundred lions led by a sheep.
townsfolk.summary: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Include the Magician in the Minion and Demon Info steps.
townsfolk.flavor: 1... 2... Abra... 3... 4... Cadabra... *poof!* And, as you can see, ladies and gentlemen, Captain Farnsworth’s bag of gold has disappeared! Gone! Without a trace! Thank you, and goodnight!
townsfolk.summary: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.

minion.firstNightReminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character.  Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
minion.otherNightReminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character.  Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
minion.flavor: Reality is merely an opinion. Specifically, my opinion.

jinxes.reason: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.

minion.summary: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.

minion.otherNightReminder: The Pit-Hag chooses a player & a character. If they chose a character that is not in play: Put the Pit-Hag to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.
minion.flavor: Round about the cauldron go; In the poison'd entrails throw; Toad, that under cold stone; Days and nights has thirty-one; Sweated venom sleeping got; Boil thou first in the charmed pot.

jinxes.reason: If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Politician, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If there is a spare token, the Pit-Hag can create an extra Village Idiot. If so, the drunk Village Idiot might change.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Cult Leader, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Goon, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Ogre, they can't turn good due to their own ability.

minion.summary: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

minion.flavor: This town has gone to the dogs, what? Cheap foreign labor... that's the ticket. Stuff them in the mine, I say. A bit of hard work never hurt anyone, and a clip'o'the ears to any brigand who says otherwise. It's all about the bottom line, what?
minion.summary: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

minion.flavor: You don’t want to insult the goblins. You really, really don’t. On a completely different note… can I have another piece of cake?
minion.summary: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.

minion.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon. Point to the player marked *IS THE MARIONETTE* and show the *THIS PLAYER IS* token and the Marionette character token.
minion.flavor: Words, words. They're all we have to go on.

jinxes.reason: The Marionette neighbors a Minion, not the Demon. The Marionette is not woken to choose who takes the Lil' Monsta token, and does not learn they are the Marionette if they have the Lil' Monsta token.
When the Poppy Grower dies, the Demon learns the Marionette but the Marionette learns nothing.
The Marionette does not learn 3 not in-play characters. The Demon learns an extra 3 instead.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Balloonist, +1 Outsider might have been added.
The Marionette does not learn that a Damsel is in play.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added.

minion.summary: You think you are a good character, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]

outsider.flavor: I am not a freak! I am a human being! Have mercy!
outsider.summary: If you are “mad” about being an Outsider, you might be executed.

outsider.firstNightReminder: If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show them the *YOU ARE* info token and their new character token.
outsider.otherNightReminder: If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show them the *YOU ARE* info token and their new character token.
outsider.summary: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.

outsider.firstNightReminder: If there are 7 or more players, wake the Lunatic: Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to any players. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 good character tokens. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and the Demon token. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* info token and the Lunatic token, then point to the Lunatic.
outsider.otherNightReminder: Do whatever needs to be done to simulate the Demon acting. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the Lunatic token & point to them, then their target(s).
outsider.flavor: I am the night... I think.
outsider.summary: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.

outsider.flavor: I'm glad you asked that question. Truly, I am. But I think the REAL question here is...
outsider.summary: If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.

demon.firstNightReminder: Declare that "The Leviathan is in play." Mark the Leviathan with the *DAY 1* reminder.
demon.otherNightReminder: Optionally, declare that "The Leviathan is in play." Replace the reminder token.
demon.flavor: To the last, I grapple with thee. From Hell’s heart, I stab at thee. For hate’s sake, I spit my last breath at thee.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan is in play, the Soldier is safe from all evil abilities.
If the Leviathan is in play, the Monk-protected-player is safe from all evil abilities.
If the Leviathan is in play, the Innkeeper-protected-players are safe from all evil abilities.
Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
If the Leviathan is in play & no execution occurs on day 5, good wins.
Evil does not win when more than 1 good player has been executed, if the Exorcist is alive and has ever successfully chosen the Leviathan.
If Leviathan is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
If the Leviathan is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Hatter dies on or after day 5, the Demon cannot choose Leviathan.
After day 5, the Pit-Hag cannot choose Leviathan.

demon.summary: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
